name: hub-supervisor-status
description: A lone app is its folder's coordinator, so /hub status carries the idle-supervisor section even while healthy (issue #283): open and stalled card counts plus any stall alerts. Wake-efficacy logic (wakes without a completed turn, failed-turn errors quoted in the alert) is covered by unit tests; this spec pins the operator-visible surface.

steps.description: the supervisor section is on /hub status while healthy
no stall alert on a freshly booted hub
